chunks: You have fulfilled your dream. Indeed, thus do We reward the good.

key_terms.الْمُحْسِنِينَ: The doers of good/those who excel

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the verse 'You have fulfilled your dream' in Shia interpretation?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is frequently linked to the fulfillment of Prophet Muhammad's (SAWW) vision of entering Mecca, serving as a divine confirmation of prophetic truth. It underscores the theological principle that God rewards the righteous (al-muhsinin) by actualizing their pious aspirations, thereby validating the spiritual and political triumph of Islam.
